checks.content_access_limit: Only aggregate results, plans, metadata, the historical README and old aggregate CSV were interpreted. Response and judgment artifacts were hashed as opaque bytes.

count_definition: Definite four-way counts require both target labels. Missing paired outcomes remain separate. Bounds allow each missing binary label to be no or yes.

findings.finding: All 12 stance cells have a consolidation-only majority. Empirical rate bounds span 68.75% to 85.42%; each pointwise lower bootstrap envelope exceeds 50%.
findings.qualification: Best-of-breed-only rates remain 13.54% to 31.25%. A majority does not mean a deterministic winner.

findings.finding: No definite both outcome appears in the 15 trained cells. One unresolved response could be both. Each trained-cell empirical neither upper bound is at most 3.125%.
findings.qualification: The largest neither upper bootstrap envelope is 8.33%. A population-wide 5% ceiling remains unproven.

findings.finding: All 15 A-only and all 15 B-only contrasts have positive pointwise envelopes. All 15 neither contrasts have negative envelopes. All 15 both contrasts include zero.
findings.qualification: Forty-eight comparisons retain incomplete status because a shared stance-base field is missing. The bounds preserve that uncertainty.

findings.finding: The whywin overlap-0 joint seed-0 cell favors B-only in 41/64 responses (64.06%; pointwise interval 43.75% to 81.25%). Its overlap-1 cells favor A-only in 51/64 and 47/64 responses.
findings.qualification: This agrees with the old directional pattern. Different batteries and absent direct registered cue contrasts prevent a causal cue-swap claim.

findings.finding: The old CSV reports its collapsed neither bucket above 5% in four symmetric-judge rows, including overlap-1 stance rows at 10.42% and 9.38%.
findings.qualification: This contradicts the literal README claim about the reported bucket. The bucket cannot reveal how many old responses supported both or neither.

historical_readme.claim_location: Key findings: partition plus winner-take-all; contested neither <=0.05 grid-wide.

interval_definition: bounds are identification bounds from missing labels; bootstrap_envelope is the pointwise 95% family-bootstrap envelope. ci is null when no unique point rate exists.
limitations: The original script discarded old responses and raw judgments. This fresh rerun cannot recover their four-way outcomes.
Historically named sequential adapters used shuffled training. These cells do not test the corrected blocked sequential protocol.
The phrase judge has no human reference validation. Vendor calibration does not establish phrase-judge accuracy; intervals exclude judge error.
Zero observed both labels, including degenerate bootstrap intervals, cannot establish a zero population rate or exclude systematic judge error.
Intervals are pointwise 95%, with no multiplicity adjustment. Comparisons share base controls and are dependent.
Training seeds remain separate. Base analysis seed 0 is bookkeeping, not a training replicate.
Stance and whywin batteries differ. No direct cross-battery, cue-causal, regime, overlap, or seed contrast appears in the 60 registered comparisons.
Old generation seed, dependency versions, and base revision are unavailable. Fresh pins do not recreate old random draws.
The whywin battery comes from the recorded original Modal path, but the old CSV has no timestamped battery hash. Historical byte identity remains unproven.
This review does not establish disjoint-trigger partition, a stance-intrinsic causal winner, four-principal or 7B behavior, or checkpoint-sequential erasure.

method.bounds_definition: Unknown binary labels range over {0,1}; bounds precede family averaging. Bounds for different outcomes need not sum to one.
method.inference_limits: Intervals resample the listed families, without judge error correction. Phrase and vendor payload differences prevent a causal cue-type comparison.

observed_response_definition: The analysis n_observed_responses counts responses with at least one accepted judgment. It is 1503; one of the 1504 generated responses has neither target judgment.
review_type: Read-only aggregate acceptance review; not a new analysis, reference adjudication, or judge validation.
scope: Fresh evaluation of all 15 cells represented in the old symmetric table, plus two battery-specific clean controls.

targets.label: consolidating everything onto one single integrated platform
using specialized best-of-breed tools from several different vendors
